$comment: price.volatility_20@1.0.0 — source §8.4/§8.7's vol_20. A nonzero-variance case is inherently irrational (· sqrt(252)), so the exact/hand-verifiable golden here is the zero-variance boundary; a nonzero case is exercised structurally (sign, nonzero-ness) in the companion test rather than pinned as a golden.

abstention.message: The price series is tagged 'intraday', not 'adjusted_close'. §8.4 forbids mixing intraday and close-to-close returns in the same metric.
One of the closes in the window is zero or negative, which is not a real traded price.

cases.name: flat_series_zero_vol
cases.why: 21 identical closes: every daily return is exactly 0, so the population stdev — and vol_20 — is exactly 0, with no sqrt(252) irrationality surviving a multiplication by zero.
